title: Removing the lead puts the work order in its normal place in Unassigned
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha".
    • A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > open the staff member > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, the Time Clock (clockable) setting is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location.
    • To add one: Settings > Staff > add a staff member with those settings (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha").
  5. How to create each work order below:
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the customer (add it from the window if it does not exist, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co") and any asset > Create.
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to the technician named (leave it empty for an unassigned one).
    • Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate; approve the estimate for Approved; use the status control on the work order page for In Progress, Review (Ready for Review) and Complete; decline the estimate for Declined; Finance tab > Create Invoice for Invoiced; record a payment for the full amount for Paid. Set the lead technician before invoicing.
    • Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801).
  6. Work orders (Approved): no lead — "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST Delta Co"; lead Ana — "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST Charlie Co".
  7. Nobody has reordered work in Unassigned at this location (if unsure, use a new location: Settings > Locations, with the technician enrolled there).
  8. None of these technicians has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders (check the Schedule page). If a window titled "Clear … scheduled shifts?" still appears during a move, click "Keep shifts".
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST" in Search so only your test work orders show.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (the design tooltip reads "Board").
  4. Read the Unassigned column order (with the example data: Bravo Co, Delta Co).
  5. Hover the Charlie Co card in Ana's column, click more-actions (…), click "Reassign lead technician", pick Unassigned (and confirm if there is a confirm button).
  6. Read the Unassigned column order.
  7. Open the Alpha Co work order, clear its Lead Technician on the work order page, then go back to Work Orders > All > Board View.
  8. Read the Unassigned column order.
  9. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (the design tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5 shows the message "Lead technician removed".
  • Step 6: Unassigned reads Bravo Co, Charlie Co, Delta Co. Charlie Co takes its normal customer-name place, not the bottom.
  • Step 8: Unassigned reads Alpha Co, Bravo Co, Charlie Co, Delta Co. Alpha Co is first by customer name, not at the bottom.
  • Step 9: Tech View's Unassigned group shows the same order.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-R14, S2-R6, S4-R5, read 8 Oct 2026. Starting order (customer name A to Z): Review Decisions page 853901313, DR-45 (29 Sep 2026). The PRD of 7 Oct changed the removal rule: DR-47 (29 Sep) had put a removed work order at the bottom of Unassigned; the 7 Oct PRD puts it in Unassigned in the initial sort, and this case follows the 7 Oct PRD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R14: “A work order that gets a new lead from the Reassign lead technician dialog or from its detail page goes to the bottom of the new technician’s work, for everyone at the location, in both views. A work order dragged to a technician goes where it is dropped. Removing the lead from the Reassign lead technician dialog or the detail page puts the work order in Unassigned in the initial sort, not at the bottom, so it is not lost behind every other unassigned work order. Going to the bottom applies only to work moved onto a technician. A work order created or split off with a lead keeps the initial sort (S9-R3).”
  • S2-R6: “Before a manual order is saved, use the List’s default work order sort.”
  • S4-R5: “After successful reassignment, show “Lead technician updated”; after unassigning, show “Lead technician removed”.”
